market_mood: The market is tense due to geopolitical risks and political shifts, but there are some opportunities amid the uncertainty.

themes.title: Democrats sweep midterm elections
themes.what_happened: Democrats have secured a sweeping victory in the midterm elections, reshaping Congress.
themes.why_it_matters: A Democratic Congress may introduce new policies affecting sectors like energy and healthcare.

our_exposure.why: Healthcare policies may impact insurance dynamics.

themes.next: Watch for policy announcements from new Congress in coming months.

themes.title: Rising geopolitical tensions in the Middle East
themes.what_happened: Tankers were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz amid Iran's regional pressures.
themes.why_it_matters: These events threaten oil supply security, affecting global energy prices.
themes.next: Monitor further escalations or de-escalations affecting crude oil prices.

themes.title: Bank of England raises interest rates
themes.what_happened: The Bank of England has raised interest rates for the first time since 2023.
themes.why_it_matters: Higher rates may influence global economic trends and investor sentiment.

our_exposure.why: Higher rates improve bank profit margins.
Interest rate hikes benefit lending revenues.

themes.next: Next BOE meeting and rate decisions in upcoming months.

themes.title: Oil prices react to geopolitical and market dynamics
themes.what_happened: Oil prices have risen over $2 post-Democratic win and Iran tensions.
themes.why_it_matters: Higher oil prices affect transportation and consumer costs broadly.

our_exposure.why: Higher oil raises consumer goods transport costs.
Increased oil prices affect supply chain costs.

themes.next: Monitor oil market reactions and further developments from Iran.
